_: Settlement sheet for the Lighter Flotilla (lane 2.5c).

norms.text: A hull casts off only on the speaker's nod.
Crews live aboard the hulls they work.

taboos.text: Taking a cargo off the anchorage outside the crew's turn.
Calling a stoppage without a vote.

values.text: The link between the deep-water hulls and the city.
Moorings that have not shifted in years.

contempts.text: Council men who write licences for work they never did.
Captains who try to beach their own boats at the quay.

place.text: Four hulls moored as houses along one pier, out of the tariff line.

work.text: Every cargo in the bay comes ashore in a lighter's hold.

people.text: The crews hold together because the city needs all of them at once.

faction.text: Compact members hold the posts; some workers here owe the guild no share.

trade.text: The market rafts sell what the tariff line never sees.

danger.text: Slaughterfish and gar work the water under the hulls.

directions.text: The landing stage runs to the Lilmoth track; boats run to the anchorage and to Archon.

addressTerms.text: Shore-foot, for anyone who came down the landing stage.

neverSaid.text: How much the crews lost in the stoppage.

grievances.text: The council tried to license lightering once; the crews stopped the port for two weeks.

rumours.text: A council member talks of dredging a deep channel.

views.text: The guild that holds the speaker's post and the right to stop the port.

dissent.text: Spends his share on the jaw beetle fights at Archon, not the Compact's dues (record lines).
No guild: mends for whoever brings a net; pays no share (record life block).
